document_quote.quote:
When SDHUFF  1, set SBSYMCODES to an array of SBNUMSYMS codes, where the length of each code is:

                                max(log2 (SDNUMINSYMS  SDNUMNEWSYMS), 1)

and the code SBSYMCODES[I] is I (for I between 0 and SBNUMSYMS – 1).

findings.rationale: The Huffman dictionary loop unconditionally invokes prepare_symbol_ids on every instances>1 step before invoking the nested symbol decoder. That macro consumes 35 four-bit run-code lengths and a transmitted run description, installs a variable-length symbol table, and byte-aligns the reader. These are normal text-region table-header operations; the dictionary procedure instead already supplies equal-length index codes and contains no such header at that location. Thus an extra wire-level table read is present on the inspected branch, independently of whether a particular conforming input happens to fail early or resemble such a header. Project configuration requires refinement aggregation and the adapter documents dictionary IDs as fixed-width; inspected project documentation supplies no intentional exception for this extra table. Review-marked contracts were used with their stated assumptions, not discarded for their human review label. This is a source-grounded format deviation, not an executed encoded-body witness, semantic proof, or whole-component conformance result. Persistent table reuse on later single-instance symbols is separately left uncertain.
findings.relevance: Applies to decoder-side Huffman symbol dictionaries with SDREFAGG=1 and REFAGGNINST>1, not ordinary Huffman text segments. Read 6.5.8.2 and Table 17 in the adjacent 6.5.8.2.2 anchor: the nested text decoder receives SBSYMCODES from 6.5.8.2.3. These are implicit equal-length index codes derived from the declared total, not a transmitted table decoded under 7.4.3.1.7. Assumes the parser reaches a nonempty multi-instance aggregation with valid imported symbol storage and adequate resources.

assumptions: The applicable role is a Huffman symbol dictionary with refinement aggregation enabled, not a standalone text region. Imported bitmap storage and delegated decoder states satisfy their existing contracts.

spec.nl: Huffman symbol-dictionary refinement/aggregation decoding is intended to preserve the dictionary-specific fixed-width symbol-ID interpretation supplied by T.88 6.5.8.2.3, rather than substituting the transmitted symbol-ID table header used by an ordinary text-region segment.

qualification: Host-checked references and quotations, not semantic conformance or proof.

review.qualification: Rows are reproduced Core deviations joined to accepted standards mappings. Exact standards quotations remain in the retained mapping records; the Markdown uses clause references and short derived requirements.

rows.observed_deviation: T.88 (08/2018) 6.5.8.2 sends multi-instance dictionary aggregates to the text decoder with Table 17 parameters. Section 6.5.8.2.3 supplies implicit equal-width index codes, not a 7.4.3.1.7 transmitted table header. Independent inspection of Tables B.1/B.2/B.4/B.6/B.8/B.11 confirms the fixture's DH=1, DW=16, aggregation count=2, initial and strip DT=1, FS=0, DS=1, OOB markers and export runs. The declared imported+new symbol total determines the fixed ID width; both instance IDs address already available imported bitmaps. RI=0 means no refinement arithmetic payload is needed. The expected output is the concatenation of the two original eight-pixel rows, derived from pre-state, not production output. Host replay reaches instances>1 and prepare_symbol_ids! on all 119 inputs (the retained LLVM branch receipt counts 119 true, 0 false at line 178). It rejects every complete encoded challenge as UnexpectedEof while trying to consume the extra table. The import-only control passes. This is a finite reproduced decoder deviation, not an oracle derived from agreement between implementation and its Verus model. The original per-case route marker was truncated from the host's output tail; the retained failure lines, exact native case and branch-coverage receipt still attribute the executed failure. Successful downstream aggregation is not observed, and removing this read alone is not claimed to repair all table bindings.

test_evidence.assertion: All imported Bitmap values are constructed by production bitmap_from_packed_bytes as 8x1 images with stride=1 and length=1, asserted before each call. Counts range from 1 through 32 with valid in-range IDs, one new/exported 16x1 symbol, two unrefined instances, default resource limits and no context reuse/custom tables. The symbol-dictionary payload is an API-level input; no file/transport wrapper is required by this entry. No private storage mutation, out-of-contract helper invocation or production source edit is used.
